items.title: Yemen's Houthis claim attack on Riyadh financial district, Aramco skyscraper damaged
items.summary: Yemen's Houthis on Sunday claimed an attack on the financial district of the Saudi capital Riyadh, with eyewitnesses saying they saw damage to a skyscraper belonging to oil giant Aramco. Aramco facilities and infrastructure have been repeatedly struck by the Houthis in recent months, with tankers, refineries, storage areas and the company headquarters all targeted by the group.

ai.sum: Houthis claimed an attack on Riyadh's financial district, and eyewitnesses reported damage to an Aramco skyscraper.

items.title: Riyadh financial district targeted, Aramco skyscraper damaged
items.summary: An Aramco building in Riyadh was targeted in an "attempted attack", the Saudi energy ministry said on Sunday, with eyewitnesses telling AFP the skyscraper sustained damage, after the Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen's Houthis said it had intercepted missiles launched by the group. Aramco facilities and infrastructure have been repeatedly struck by the Houthis in recent months, with tankers, refineries, storage areas and the company headquarters all targeted by the group.

ai.sum: Saudi authorities said an Aramco building in Riyadh's financial district was targeted in an attempted attack, with eyewitnesses reporting damage to the skyscraper.

items.title: Riyadh financial district targeted, Aramco tower damaged: witnesses
items.summary: Multiple witnesses told AFP on Sunday that Riyadh's financial district was targeted and the area's Aramco tower was damaged, after the Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen's Houthis said it had intercepted missiles launched by the group. "Aramco tower in KAFD has been targeted, that's the sure thing," said one witness, referring to the King Abdullah Financial District. Two other witnesses confirmed seeing damage to the building.

ai.sum: Witnesses told AFP that Riyadh's financial district was targeted and the Aramco tower damaged after Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted Houthi missiles.
